mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values(#{name},#{room},#{beginDate},#{endDate},#{masterId},#{subject},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name},
room=#{room},
begin_date = #{beginDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
master_id = #{masterId},
subject = #{subject},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select c.id, c.name, c.room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, c.create_time, c.update_time,e.name master_name , case when now() > c.end_date then '已结课' when now() < c.begin_date then '未开班' else '已开班' end status from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id
c.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and c.end_date between #{begin} and #{end}
order by update_time desc
